# Personal ToS — Terms & Conditions of Being Me

> Parody generator that renders your own Terms of Service as the exact UI everyone
> scrolls past on app launches — long clause text, "I agree" button, fine print —
> then exports it as one finished shareable image.
> Deterministic generation, zero runtime AI, no accounts, no tracking.

The site has four tools. Each runs fully client-side, needs no login, and produces
a shareable PNG or link. State is encoded in the URL (no backend, no cookies).
Japanese versions of every tool live under /ja/.

## Tools

- [Personal ToS generator](https://personal-tos.sunnydachs.workers.dev/): render your own Terms & Conditions of Being Me as an app-launch ToS modal; export as PNG or shareable link. 8 operating-condition traits.
- [Today (resolution card)](https://personal-tos.sunnydachs.workers.dev/resolution): roll a deterministic daily resolution card and share it as a PNG.
- [Take The Blame For Me Gacha](https://personal-tos.sunnydachs.workers.dev/substitute): summon a deterministic daily substitute and share the blame card.
- [Modern Human Status Screen](https://personal-tos.sunnydachs.workers.dev/status): render an RPG-style status screen for a modern human (HP/MP, resolution, verdict icons) and share it as a PNG.

## Optional

- [Japanese version](https://personal-tos.sunnydachs.workers.dev/ja): 全ツールの日本語版。
- [Source code](https://github.com/sunnydachs/personal-tos): Next.js 16 + vinext on Cloudflare Workers; vitest-tested state codec and clause assembly; MIT-style parody content.
